text:
sacha: FYI — saw two related CVE disclosures this morning we need to triage together: cert-manager CVE-2026-0421 (webhook privilege escalation) and nginx-ingress dependency CVE-2026-0718 (path parsing). Thinking a coordinated, reversible rollout. :eyes:

amanda: ack. can you paste the minimal impact details?

sacha: cert-manager: CVSS 8.1, requires new webhook RBAC in 1.12.0; exploit allows CSR objects to be mutated via webhook path. nginx-ingress: CVSS 7.4, fixed in 1.8.3, affects path normalization when using custom regex. both are in our infra chart templates.

kevin: staging runs cert-manager v1.11.2 and nginx-ingress 1.8.1. propose wave: dev -> staging -> two small prod clusters -> rest. agree?

irene: security-bot flagged cert-manager as P1 because of potential privilege escalation if webhook SA can mutate CSRs. we need RBAC delta review + KMS policy check if cert-manager will talk to KMS for private key storage during rotation.

security-bot: CVE-2026-0421 severity: 8.1. recommended immediate triage. tag: p1.

marcus: quick checklist I want in the plan: preflight CRD diffs, kube-apiserver audit filter add (capture CertificateRequest.*), canary traffic generator for ingress rules, and a fast rollback path.

amanda: added a preflight job draft in the repo, see snippet: 
```
# run from ci-agent with kubeconfig-staging
kubectl --context staging diff -f ./helm-charts/cert-manager/templates/
helm upgrade --install cert-manager ./helm-charts/cert-manager --namespace cert-manager --atomic --wait --timeout 10m
```

kevin: RBAC delta (excerpt) — new ClusterRole rules required by 1.12: 
```yaml
- apiGroups: ["certificates.k8s.io"]
  resources: ["certificatesigningrequests"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch","create","update","patch"]
```
We need to ensure cluster-admin approval for that change in prod; can't auto-approve during canary.

irene: KMS question — are we using our KMS key for sealing cert-manager secrets? cert-manager uses Secret resources; our envelope encryption is at rest via KMS. Need key policy updated to allow cert-manager SA in the staging account to use the key for decrypt/encrypt? tagging @security to confirm.

sacha: For rollback plan: 
1) kubectl rollout undo deployment/cert-manager -n cert-manager
2) reapply previous helm revision: helm rollback cert-manager <rev>
3) disable cert-manager webhook by scaling to 0 or patching ValidatingWebhookConfiguration to remove hooks temporarily if needed.

amanda: adding an automated watch job to fail the canary if any CertificateRequest status==Failure for more than 5m. snippet: 
```bash
# simple watcher
kubectl get certificaterequests --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.status.conditions[]?.type=="Denied")'
```

kevin: ask infra: can we stage the nginx-ingress update in the same wave or stagger by one wave? mixing might complicate rollback. my preference: cert-manager first (higher severity) then nginx-ingress one wave later.

marcus: agree with kevin. cert-manager has RBAC/KMS implications — do that first. nginx-ingress can be scheduled for next maintenance window if canary is clean.

security-bot: Note: add audit rule to central audit pipeline: match objectRef.resource=="certificaterequests" OR resource=="certificatesigningrequests". Keep 30d retention for this window.

deploy-bot: canary started: cert-manager v1.12.0 -> staging at 2109801320. Monitoring hooks: cert-requests watcher, webhook error logs stream.

amanda: canary logs: cert-manager webhook pod `cert-manager-webhook-5f8d7` shows one 500 at 2109801354, stack trace points to admission mutate path but request replay didn't persist. investigating.

kevin: if webhook 500s continue, next step: patch webhook configuration to reject-admission=false or scale webhook to 0 to stop admission until we rollback. Remember that disabling webhook may allow invalid resources through; plan for that risk.

irene: I've opened a KMS policy PR to allow cert-manager SA encryption: link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/412 — needs one more approver from security.

sacha: good. timeline: start canary now, 30m health window, if no failures promote to staging-wide, then 2 prod clusters in next hour, then full roll tomorrow low-traffic. keep nginx-ingress held for next window.

marcus: add note for runbook: if cert-manager webhook exploit is observed, rotate its webhook TLS certs and revoke impacted keys via KMS, and run clusterwide CSR scan: 
```bash
kubectl get csr -o wide | grep Pending
# check for unexpected signers/issuers
```

amanda: update: after rolling back to 1.11.2 in the canary, the 500s stopped. pushing the rollback fix and opening a postmortem thread with root cause. :white_check_mark:

sacha: thanks all. action items captured: amanda (canary ops + postmortem), kevin (rollout sequencing + rollback docs), irene (KMS PR), marcus (audit pipeline changes), sacha (coordinate nginx window). we'll reconvene if security-bot escalates.
